descriptions.zh: 一种微弱而重复的能量特征，每当有舰船驶过该恒星系时就会从这个小行星中发出。
descriptions.en: A subtle repeating energy pattern emanates from this asteroid any time ships travel through the system.

descriptions.zh: 在虚境里迷失的科研船的波动残像，零星地出现在整个恒星系中。
descriptions.en: A fluctuating afterimage of the science ship lost to the Shroud appears sporadically throughout the system.

descriptions.zh: 开始研究被称为“清醒”的街头毒品的作用。
descriptions.en: Begin researching the effects of the street drug known as 'Lucid'.

descriptions.zh: 继续研究街头毒品“清醒”的作用。
descriptions.en: Continue researching the effects of the street drug 'Lucid'.

descriptions.zh: 这个看上去像是异星人舰船的外壳被发现漂浮在[floating_shell_system.GetName]星系。它是怎么到达那里的，这艘舰船的其他部分在哪里？
descriptions.en: The shell of what looks like an alien vessel was found floating in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system. How did it get there, and where is the rest of the ship?

descriptions.zh: 外星舰船的最后一部分出现在了[floating_core_system.GetName]星系。我们的工程师需要时间重新组装这艘舰船。
descriptions.en: The final piece of the alien ship has appeared in the [floating_core_system.GetName]. Our engineers need time to reassemble the vessel.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上获得了一个不寻常的信号，似乎是在尝试与我们联系。然而我们还不能与这个信号源进行沟通，如果想对其了解更多，我们需要派遣一艘舰船进行仔细检查。
descriptions.en: We have picked up on uncommon signals coming from [From.GetName], seemingly trying to initiate contact with us. We have been unable to communicate with whatever or whoever it is, and will have to send a ship to inspect it more closely if we want to learn more about what it might be.

descriptions.zh: 我们捕捉到了一些信号，表明在[prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]可能存在更有价值的资源有待发现。我们已经发射了一些先验探针对这一区域进行遍寻——这样当我们能够派遣一艘舰船前往的时候，我们就能获得足够的数据进行深入研究。
descriptions.en: We have picked up on signals indicating there might be more valuable resources to be uncovered at [prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]. We have sent some preliminary drones to scour the region - so it will be ready for further analysis and work when we can send a ship there.

descriptions.zh:
一处怪异的引力井突然出现在[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]的上空，扰乱了许多我们的人造卫星轨道。殖民地本身尚未受到威胁，但这一现象出现在我们的一处殖民点附近，还是造成了不便。

此外，如果我们不加干预，许多在[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]上空运转的卫星将面临着提前坠落的风险。一旦发生，显然这将会实实在在地妨碍我们研究新生成的重力井的能力。
descriptions.en:
A strange gravity well suddenly appeared above [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName], disrupting many of our satellite orbits. The colony itself doesn't seem to be under threat yet, but this phenomenon is situated uncomfortably close to one of our colonies.

Furthermore, many of the satellites we placed above [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] face an early de-orbiting if we do not intervene soon. Should that happen, it would significantly hamper our ability to study the new gravity well in detail.

descriptions.zh: 某个宣称自己是一名传奇英雄的个体来到了我们的母星。这样的暴论有可能是真的吗？
descriptions.en: An individual claiming to be a legendary hero has appeared on our homeworld. Could their wild assertions possibly be true?
